change: Alien Stand (MrAlienEvent) admin event: prepare the ReplicatedStorage.Assets.AdminEvents.MrAlienEvent template for runtime cloning into Workspace.Map, and default the HUD EventButton.AlienIcon to hidden.
rollback: Delete the IdleAnimationId attribute from ReplicatedStorage.Assets.AdminEvents.MrAlienEvent.Alien, set its HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false, set ModelStreamingMode = Default on Alien/UFO/AlienPlatform, and set ReplicatedStorage.UI.HUD.LeftButtons.EventButton.AlienIcon.Visible = true.
notes: IdleAnimationId is the same stock R6 idle the Beekeeper uses (rbxassetid://180435571). The rig has no bundled Animate LocalScript, so AlienStandController loads and plays the track itself, exactly as BeeCampController does for the Beekeeper.

Only HumanoidRootPart is anchored, matching the Beekeeper: the rest of the rig hangs off Motor6Ds so the idle track and the procedural neck tilt both still animate. AlienStandService re-anchors it defensively on every clone, so a template regression cannot drop the NPC through the platform.

Persistent streaming matches the Bee camp's Jar/Beekeeper. The template is authored in place at x~21, z~-63 to -68 (about 56 studs north of Map.CENTER), so the runtime clone keeps its authored CFrames and needs no spawn marker.

AlienIcon was authored Visible = true and sits directly on top of the default Icon at the same size/position/ZIndex. HudController now owns both: Icon shows by default and the pair swaps while the stand is up.
